goal: Replace parallel content and rendering paths with one Markdown-to-typed-IR-to-registry-to-Smart-gateway-to-layout pipeline.
immutable_rules: One locale route, exactly one content/<locale>/<route>.md source.
content/<locale>/lang.json is the only shared public UI translation source.
Public resources/i18n and site.json compatibility are absent; CLI/build messages are package-owned and outside public builds.
Typed IR is created in memory; optional serialization and HTML are derived and disposable.
One renderer registry and one Smart gateway.
One PageBuilder pipeline for full and page builds; only the selected route set differs.
Delete unpublished legacy after evidence; do not preserve it by default.
next_action: Ask the user to deploy or not deploy the exact candidate to docara.test; if approved, repeat live preflight and execute the verified cutover/rollback dossier.
unverified_compatibility: live docara.test cutover and post-cutover production acceptance
